label: caiso 42 atc hydro
definition: Adds corridor ATC forward envelope (PNW 0.43 / DSW 0.56 base fractions from measured p95 deliverability) and EIA-930 monthly hydro budget (fixes 2025 hydro gap 12→20 TWh). Carries all caiso-41 structural mechanisms: RA must-offer (min_load_frac 0.26), negative renewable offers, endogenous solar spill, CT net-load drag, gas hub basis overlay, reliability floor.
